queue.title: Queue
queue.desc: A linear data structure that follows First-In, First-Out (FIFO) order.

deque.title: DeQue
deque.desc: A double-ended queue that allows insertion and deletion at both ends.

bitree.title: Binary Tree
bitree.desc: A hierarchical data structure where each node has at most two children.

bst.title: Binary Search Tree
bst.desc: A binary tree where left nodes are smaller and right nodes are larger.

graph.title: Train Route
graph.desc: A graph representation showing stations as nodes and routes as edges.

sorting.title: Sorting Algorithm
sorting.desc: Algorithms used to arrange data in a specific order such as ascending or descending.
